copychat.name: CopyChat
copychat.config.show_copy_button.descrip: Show a copy button when you point at a chat message.
copychat.config.click_anywhere_to_copy.d: Copy the pointed-at chat message when clicking anywhere across its row instead of only the copy button.
Use the right mouse button instead of the left one for the copy button, avoiding conflicts with other chat controls.
copychat.config.require_shift_to_copy.de: Only copy when Shift is held while clicking the copy button, preventing accidental clipboard replacement.
copychat.config.copy_as_json.description: Copy Minecraft's structured component JSON instead of visible plain text. This preserves text styles and click or hover data.
copychat.config.show_copy_feedback.descr: Replace the copy icon with a check mark or cross after a copy attempt.
